VBO:0201282.summary: Spitz dogs are often loyal and affectionate, with an independent, bold streak. Their working histories span sled hauling, hunting and herding, rather than one shared task. Alaskan Malamutes carried heavy loads over long distances, Finnish Spitz signal game birds with rapid barking, and the sociable Samoyed formed close bonds while working with northern herders.
VBO:0201282.shortDescription: Often affectionate yet independent, Spitz dogs unite varied working histories, from sled hauling to finding game.
